outcome: time taken between delivery of baby to delivery of placenta
cohort: 400 antenatal women at term with singleton pregnancies scheduled for cesarean section
finding: Manual removal of placenta was associated with greater blood loss, a greater fall in hemoglobin, higher incidence of fever, post-operative uterine tenderness, subinvolution of the uterus, and endometritis, but a shorter time interval between delivery of the baby and the placenta compared to spontaneous delivery of the placenta.
